div.l: Now draweth cut / for that is myn accord
Cometh neer qdquod he / my lady prioresse
And ye sire clerk / and lat be yowr shamfastnesse
Ne studyeth nat / leyth hond to everi man ·
A noon to drawe / every wiht bi gan ·
And shortly for to tellyn / as it was
Wer it bi aventure / or soort or caas
The soth is this / the cut fel to the knyht
Of which wel blyth / and glad / was every wyht
And tellyn he moste his tale / bi resoıı̄un
By forward / and bi composicioıı̄un
As ye han herd / what nedeth wordys moo
And whan this good mān / saw that it was soo
As he that wys was / and obedyent
To kepe his forward / bi his free assent
He seyde syn · I shal / bigynne this game
What wolcom̄e be / the cutt / a godys name
Now late vs ryde / and herkeneth what I say
And with that word / we redyn · forth our way
And bi gan · / with ryht a mery chere
His tale a noon · / and seyde as ye may heere
Explicit prologus
